reason_answer: To have my gallbladder taken out.

presentation.summary: Ms Hina, 29, last period 7 weeks ago. The urine pregnancy test is positive. She may not have known; this needs private, sensitive handling.

history.answer: Attacks of pain under the ribs after fatty meals.
No fever, no yellow eyes; no vaginal bleeding; no pain in the lower tummy.
No anaesthetic problems in the family.
My last period was seven weeks ago. I did not think about it.

examination.finding: Soft; mild tenderness under the right ribs; no lower tummy tenderness.

scores.name: NEWS2
scores.note: All vital signs in the normal band

problems.label: Positive pregnancy test before planned surgery
problems.why: Changes imaging, drugs, anaesthesia and timing; she has no pain or bleeding, so ectopic pregnancy is not suspected but must be kept in mind.
expected_actions: Do not proceed with planned surgery
Senior surgeon, anaesthetist and the obstetric team decide
Safety-net advice: lower tummy pain, bleeding, shoulder-tip pain or dizziness means come straight back

decisions.prompt: The pregnancy test is positive. What now?

options.text: Postpone the planned surgery; the senior surgeon, anaesthetist and obstetric team decide; discuss it privately and sensitively
Proceed because she has no pain in her lower tummy
options.consequence: Pregnancy status changes drugs, imaging and anaesthesia.

options.text: Tell her in front of other patients

decisions.prompt: What if her gallbladder trouble became urgent during the pregnancy?

options.text: Laparoscopic cholecystectomy is possible in any trimester when needed (SAGES); for non-urgent surgery the second trimester is usual
options.consequence: ISS-0017: the book prefers the second trimester; SAGES allows any trimester when surgery is needed.

options.text: Surgery is never possible in pregnancy

correct: Do the pregnancy test per policy
Involve the senior, anaesthetist and obstetric team

incorrect.mistake: Does not do the pregnancy test
incorrect.shows: The anaesthetist asks at Sign In
incorrect.risk: Unknown pregnancy status: a hard safety failure

missed: Not asking about the last period

debrief.why_priority: It changes surgery, drugs and imaging
debrief.if_ignored: Unplanned exposure to drugs or imaging
debrief.remember: Always know the pregnancy status before surgery
